correctness.rationale: Two inverse branches for each target have reciprocal derivatives z/(1+z), 1/(1+z), verifying Lebesgue invariance; a strict-expansion cylinder argument makes the branch partition generating. The resulting conditional-entropy integral is exact. Fixed-output monotonicity of the power parameter proves strict decrease. Dominated Taylor expansion at B=1 and finite log-moment expansion at infinity yield -1/4 and C,J; exact-rational inverse weights and two independent numerical quadratures passed. All domain conventions and limits are stated in RESULT.md.

value.rationale: Entropy is a natural system-level dynamical invariant not fixed by spatial Lebesgue invariance. The theorem gives the strict complete parameter ordering, quadratic information-loss onset at the Bernoulli endpoint and zeta-valued two-term collapse at extreme intermittency. These answer a motivated whole-family question complementary to the source paper’s residence-time and correlation transitions, rather than tabulating an arbitrary finite example.
